transactions.description: Tax Deferred Roll-over of IRA into TSP. Stock held in my IRA at Raymond James. Due to balance requirement at Raymond James of $10,000, I was forced to sell the stocks and then I rolled the balance into my TSP via the TSP rollover process, never touching or having access to the funds.
